en.summary: This one-page PDF is another byte-distinct copy of SDNY Document 183. It states that Jamie Scher entered an appearance for 3,345 Himalaya Exchange customers in criminal case 23 Cr. 118. It is not a merits ruling or judicial validation of the represented group.
en.plainEnglish: This is another stored copy of the same lawyer sign-in page. It should improve source resilience, not multiply the number of appearances or prove the customers' claims.
legalReading: The body is stamped Case 1:23-cr-00118-AT, Document 183, filed December 6, 2023; that body identification is more specific than the local discovery caseId.
Scher states that he is admitted in New York and SDNY and appears for 3,345 Himalaya Exchange customers.
The page is signed by Scher and contains no judicial signature, order, factual findings, or relief.
The notice does not establish intervention, standing, customer identity, ownership, loss, restitution, or forfeiture rights.
caseConnections: Its extracted text is identical to the sdny-23-cr-118 Doc 183 copy and another discovery copy, despite different PDF SHA-256 values.
Doc 185 is a separate same-day notice concerning Bradford Geyer and pending pro hac vice admission.
whyItMatters: It permits version-locked review of this binary while preserving logical deduplication.
It documents representation chronology without overstating substantive effect.
verificationTasks: Group all three Doc 183 binaries under one logical filing after comparison with the official docket.
Check subsequent orders for any legally operative treatment of the represented customers.
riskFlags: The local discovery label does not change the SDNY case identification printed in the PDF.
The 3,345 figure is counsel's statement and no list is attached.
A duplicate copy is not a second judicial event or independent proof.

findings.text: The page is SDNY Document 183 and states that Jamie Scher appeared for 3,345 Himalaya Exchange customers.
Its extracted text exactly matches two other Doc 183 corpus copies.
The notice has no adjudicative effect on standing, ownership, victim status, or recovery.

zh.summary: 这份 1 页 PDF 是 SDNY Document 183 的另一份二进制副本。文件称 Jamie Scher 在刑事案 23 Cr. 118 中代表 3,345 名 Himalaya Exchange 客户出庭。它不是实体裁判，也不是法院对该群体的司法认证。
zh.plainEnglish: 这是同一张“律师签到页”的另一个保存副本。它能提高资料来源的稳健性，但不能增加出庭次数，也不能证明客户请求成立。
legalReading: 正文标注 Case 1:23-cr-00118-AT、Document 183，于 2023 年 12 月 6 日提交；该正文识别比本地 discovered caseId 更具体。
Scher 称自己已获准在纽约州和 SDNY 执业，并代表 3,345 名 Himalaya Exchange 客户出庭。
该页由 Scher 签署，没有法官签名、法院命令、事实认定或救济。
通知不证明介入、standing、客户身份、所有权、损失、赔偿或没收权利。
caseConnections: 虽然 PDF SHA-256 不同，其提取正文与 sdny-23-cr-118 Doc 183 副本及另一发现副本完全相同。
Doc 185 是同日涉及 Bradford Geyer 及其待批准 pro hac vice 的另一份通知。
whyItMatters: 它支持对本二进制文件进行版本锁定复核，同时保持逻辑去重。
它记录代理时间线，但不夸大实体法律效果。
verificationTasks: 与正式案卷核对后，把三个 Doc 183 二进制副本归入一个逻辑文件。
检查后续命令是否对受代理客户作出任何具有法律效力的处理。
riskFlags: 本地发现标签不会改变 PDF 正文印明的 SDNY 案件身份。
3,345 人是律师陈述，文件没有附名单。
重复副本不是第二次司法事件或独立证据。

findings.text: 该页为 SDNY Document 183，称 Jamie Scher 代表 3,345 名 Himalaya Exchange 客户出庭。
其提取正文与另外两份 Doc 183 资料库副本完全一致。
该通知对 standing、所有权、受害人身份或获偿没有裁判效力。
